[EN] It's a horrible place! Hurry, run away! Why are you here? I said run away! Quickly!

...No, where are you going? Hahaha isn't it thrilling here? Listen, listen to all these screaming! It's thrilling and driving me crazy! Driving me crazyyyyyy!

...No, ¿a dónde vas? Jajaja, ¿acaso no es emocionante aquí? ¡Escucha, escucha todos esos gritos! ¡Es emocionante y me vuelve loco! ¡Me vuelve locooxxx!
